Kimberly — thanks for the ping. I reviewed Helio's ask and put together high-level redline guidance below. Drafts attached: Helio_MSA_redline_v1.docx (tracked changes) and Orderform_HELIO_18mo.xlsx.

Redline highlights / legal positions (summary):
- Term: we can agree to an 18-month firm term effective 2027-07-01. Add language that the customer may elect to renew at the end of the 18 months subject to then-current pricing.
- Termination-for-convenience: Helio's requested explicit 90-day post-12-month window is a change from our standard 12-month notice requirements. Proposed compromise: allow either party to terminate with 90 days' notice after month 12 but require pro-rated settlement for committed capacity through the earlier of: (i) contract termination date; or (ii) 180 days after notice. This protects Redwood's committed capacity economics.
- SLA credits / liability: Acceptable to preserve current SLA terms but carve out an aggregated monthly credit cap (e.g., credits limited to X% of monthly fees) rather than open-ended liability given longer committed term. Legal will populate the specific cap and cross-check with Finance.
- Data retention & export: Helio asked clarity on data retention on termination; propose explicit export window of 30 days with optional paid retention add-on.
- Order form: We'll incorporate the +20% uplift line item, call out start/end dates, and include the PO reference number. Naomi — confirm pricing bands and any one-time credit you recommend; I left a placeholder in the order form.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Naomi to propose pricing exception/one-time credit number and confirm revenue impact.
2) Legal to finalize tracked redline (attached) and circulate to Helio for comment.
3) If Helio accepts redlines, send DocuSign package (Orderform + MSA redline summary) and route to procurement.

Attachments: Helio_MSA_redline_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), Orderform_HELIO_18mo.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
